comment: Accounts of the browser UI (ui:). api_users documents gain role (user|admin; missing: user) and password_hash (PHC argon2id string; missing or null: no UI login). api_sessions: _id is the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the session token (never the token), user_id its user, created_at and expires_at database times. Deleting a user deletes its keys and sessions first.
